notes: Nucleus: the clip was not a tone-map problem - fs_star multiplies colour by color.a * gain, and color.a is the reveal, so a brightness-0.02 nucleus star and a brightness-1 arm star emitted identical light; 289 impostors summed to ~13 and clipped. Folding brightness into the packed RGB made brightness an amplitude: plateau 11131 px -> 12 px. Home star: gap ring HOME_GAP_PX 8.0 at 1080p measured from the glare, not the centre; peak now 0.887 at the exact frame centre. Arms: rendered ridge/trough 10.67 at 1080p vs 9.65 at 4K, so the arms survive the downscale; ARM_CONTRAST_FULL raised 0.16 -> 0.42 because the measured modulation is 0.427 (0.422-0.441 over 12 seeds) and the old constant saturated every seed to 1.0 (HUD diagnostic only, never reaches the shader). Dust band: the boot frame had no band because the disc lay in world y=0; GALACTIC_PLANE_TILT_RAD -30 deg gives a real band from the disc population, axis ratio 1.25 -> 4.17, ~52000 lit px. The tilt is a proven pure rigid rotation of the same population (max relative diff 3.9e-16 on disc-only rows), so GALAXY_STREAM_VERSION 3 keeps the stream stable while GALAXY_VERSION 4 re-pins shared links. GALLERY_PITCH = PITCH + tilt stays: orbitTo(0, PITCH) gives lod 0.016 (collapsed, edge-on) vs orbitTo(0, PITCH + tilt) 1.000. Blindspot copy: the visual-review manifest claimed native size but the crops were downscaled; they are now copied verbatim. Two regressions were found and fixed while wrapping up: (1) the home-star gap inverted its own smoothstep edges below lod 0.7 (outer edge 8*lod fell under the constant inner 5.6), erasing the whole galaxy at intermediate legibility - the reported 'disappears at some pitches' and 'vanishes then reappears while zooming in'; both edges now derive from the same value, and three tests fail on the old expression; (2) the HUD scene row keyed off lod, which folds in inclination, so a straight edge-on zoom-out read 'K-type - 9 planets' at 45000 ly - it now reads identity = fit * resolved.
